meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 拆任务为多个可独立合并的小改动,每个在独立工作区实现,强制人工验证并留证据;自动创建英文PR,跑CI和Cubic,全通过则默认合并并清理。不过就修复重验。
howto.when: 当用户说“创建 PR”“实现并提 PR”“处理 issue”等,或语境表明要以 PR 交付时触发;甚至只说“实现 X”但隐含 PR 需求也会触发。

say.text: 把 issue #42 拆成小 PR 并全部实现合并。
say.note: 会先规划拆分,然后并行处理每个 PR。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动做成 PR,走完整验证流程。
say.note: 会自动创建 PR、跑 CI 和 Cubic,通过后合并。

say.text: 用 PR 流程交付这个功能,最后清理工作区。
say.note: 全程包含手动验证、自动检查和默认合并。

howto.what_en: Splits a task into minimal mergeable PRs, implements each in a dedicated worktree with evidence-bound manual QA, creates an English PR, runs CI+Cubic, auto-merges by default when green, cleans up. Failure sends back to fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says things like 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'implement issue', or the context implies delivery as a PR — even a bare 'implement X' works if a PR is expected.

say_en.text: Split issue #42 into small PRs and implement all of them.
say_en.note: It will plan the split, then handle each PR in parallel.

say_en.text: Turn this change into a PR and run the full verification.
say_en.note: It will create the PR, run CI+Cubic, and merge when green.

say_en.text: Deliver this feature via the PR workflow and clean up after.
say_en.note: Includes manual QA, automated checks, and default merge.
